IPC Programme POC API (1.0.0)

Download OpenAPI specification:Download

License: LicenseRef-Proprietary

Programme Edge public API (/ipc/v1) and private workflow API (/internal) for the IPC programme on ELEVATE.

Contract-first definition (Constitution Principle V) for the IPC Programme POC.

  • Public operations live under /ipc/v1 on the Programme Edge, the only public entry point (Caddy TLS :443). Root /healthz, /readyz, /dependencies are the Edge's own health routes.
  • Private operations live under /internal on the workflow service, reachable only on the private compose network. They are tagged internal and are never routed by the Edge (US9 AS7). The Edge forwards governance calls to workflow with the same request/response shapes, carrying the acting user in a service JWT; those mirrored routes are not repeated here.

Conventions (details in contracts/README.md):

  • Browser writes: session cookie ipc_sid (httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict) and X-CSRF-Token.
  • Every write (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) carries Idempotency-Key (UUID, kept 7 days per user). A replay returns the stored response with Idempotent-Replayed: true; the same key with a different body is refused with 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. login is the only exception (no user yet).
  • Writes on versioned resources carry If-Match: "<v>". A stale v gets 409 VERSION_CONFLICT whose body carries the current resource (current) for the differences view (FR-016).
  • Errors are RFC 9457 application/problem+json with a stable code and correlationId.
  • Scope is always derived on the server; any scope, facility or role claimed in a request body is ignored (FR-028). 403 policy: a resource outside the caller's scope (or an id that does not exist) returns 403 SCOPE_DENIED, so existence is not disclosed; a resource in scope where the caller is not the owner or assignee the operation requires returns 403 NOT_OWNER. Both are written to the ledger.
  • Free text is at most 500 characters. Lists are cursor-paginated (limit 1-100, default 25).
  • No patient data field exists anywhere in this contract (FR-032).

Extensions: x-roles lists the roles allowed (scope still applies); x-requirements lists the FR/US ids the operation serves.

auth

Sign-in through ELEVATE's own login, session and current user.

Sign in with ELEVATE identifier and password

Calls ELEVATE user-service login, stores ELEVATE tokens encrypted server-side and sets the ipc_sid cookie. Password login only in the POC (OTP is a pilot upgrade). Exempt from Idempotency-Key and CSRF (no session yet).

Request Body schema: application/json
required
identifier
required
string <= 254 characters

ELEVATE email or phone.

password
required
string <= 256 characters
client
required
string
Enum: "web" "field"
deviceId
string <uuid>

Responses

Programme Edge (public, TLS). Serves /ipc/v1 and the Edge health routes.

https://ipc.localhost/ipc/v1/auth/login

IPC workflow service (private network only). Serves /internal.

http://workflow:8080/ipc/v1/auth/login

Upload a facility-master or staff (HR) file for import into ELEVATE

Starts an asynchronous import job run by the adapters service. Facility rows create or update ELEVATE entities (facility code = externalId) and the ward register; HR rows create or update ELEVATE users and programme scopes, and users marked as left are deactivated, their scope ends and their open tasks appear in the supervisor's "needs reassignment" view.

Authorizations:
(sessionCookiecsrfToken)
header Parameters
Idempotency-Key
required
string <uuid>

Client-generated UUID, stored with user, method, path and request hash for 7 days. Replays return the stored response.

Request Body schema: multipart/form-data
required
kind
required
string
Enum: "facility" "hr"
file
required
string <text/csv>

CSV, at most 5 MB. Facility rows carry facility code, district, level, location and wards; HR rows carry staff id, name, contact, role, facility/ward codes, status (active or left). No patient data.

dryRun
boolean
Default: false

Responses

Programme Edge (public, TLS). Serves /ipc/v1 and the Edge health routes.

https://ipc.localhost/ipc/v1/admin/imports

IPC workflow service (private network only). Serves /internal.

http://workflow:8080/ipc/v1/admin/imports

  • "v": 0
}

Change retention periods or purge mode

Defaults per proposal A6 (evidence 3 years after plan closure, audit 7 years, other records 5 years after programme end). The POC runs purges in dry_run mode. Writes the ledger action retention.changed (subject retention_policy) with before/after fingerprints in the same transaction. Deletion of patient-showing media is not governed here (FR-032, immediate).

Start an assessment of a ward for a cycle and get its offline form bundle

Called by the field app while online, when downloading a ward for offline use. Creates the ELEVATE samiksha observation for the ward (data.entities = the ward's ELEVATE entity) on the cycle's observation solution and the programme AssessmentContext (status draft), and returns the assessmentId with the form bundle (checklist version and content hash). Repeating the call for the same caller, ward and cycle while a draft is open returns that draft (200). Ward outside scope → 403 SCOPE_DENIED; caller not assigned to assess the ward → 403 NOT_OWNER.

Submit answers with the no-patient-data declaration

Answers reference confirmed evidence ids only (photos sync first). The Edge checks scope and ownership and writes to samiksha with the caller's ELEVATE token. Without declaration.accepted → 422 DECLARATION_REQUIRED. Draft built on a version retired past its grace period → 422 CHECKLIST_VERSION_RETIRED (restart on the new version). Scope changed since download → 403 SCOPE_DENIED; ward in scope but the caller is not the assessment's assessor → 403 NOT_OWNER.

Evidence-based data-quality exceptions (served by the Edge, which owns evidence)

Served by the Edge on its private listener, not by workflow; workflow merges these with its own exceptions (no baseline, stale device queue) for listDataQualityExceptions. Returns the evidence-based kinds: PHOTO_NO_GPS, GPS_FAR_FROM_FACILITY (> 1 km from the facility point), DEVICE_CLOCK_SKEW (> 10 min), LATE_UPLOAD (capture to upload > 7 days) and DUPLICATE_PHOTO_ACROSS_WARDS (same SHA-256 in two wards). Also returns deviceQueues: every reported device outbox (DeviceQueueStatus, owned by the Edge) that still holds unsent items (pendingCount > 0). Workflow applies the 72 h rule on programme time and turns the old ones into STALE_DEVICE_QUEUE exceptions.

Authorizations:
serviceJwt
query Parameters
kind
string
Enum: "PHOTO_NO_GPS" "GPS_FAR_FROM_FACILITY" "DEVICE_CLOCK_SKEW" "LATE_UPLOAD" "DUPLICATE_PHOTO_ACROSS_WARDS"
facilityId
string (ObjectId) ^[a-f0-9]{24}$
wardId
string (ObjectId) ^[a-f0-9]{24}$
since
string <date-time>
cursor
string <= 512 characters

Opaque cursor from a previous page's nextCursor.

limit
integer [ 1 .. 100 ]
Default: 25

Responses

Edge private listener (private network only; not exposed on the public :443 entry point).

http://edge:8081/internal/evidence/data-quality
